title: Tôi có cần điền vào mẫu đơn này không?
englishTitle: Do I need to fill out this form?
pronunciation: Toi co can dien vao mau don nay khong
summary: For checking whether an arrival, customs, baggage, hotel, or transport form actually needs to be filled before you move on.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Hold up the paper or phone form first. The answer should tell you fill it, skip it, or go to the right counter.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the form and keep your passport, boarding pass, or booking nearby if staff need to compare details.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có cần điền vào mẫu đơn này không?
phrases.english: Do I need to fill out this form?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co can dien vao mau don nay khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi có cần means do I need; điền vào means fill in; mẫu đơn này means this form; không makes it a yes/no question.

breakdown.vietnamese: Tôi có cần điền vào mẫu đơn này không?
breakdown.english: Do I need to fill out this form?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Passport, visa, baggage tag, mistake, and signature cards cover the document questions around the form.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Airport desks, immigration counters, baggage offices, hotels, and transport counters are the moments where this question saves time.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If staff point to one box, fill only that part before asking again. Some forms are only for certain passports, bags, or bookings.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move to passport, visa, wrong-form, signature, written-report, or pickup cards if the form leads to another document step.
